ValidationRule.description: Requires Deal Review Status to be Approved before advancing to Solutioning, Negotiation, Booking Verification, Setup, or Closing stages. Applies to Standard Opportunity Record type only.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity', ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closing') ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Deal_Review_Status__c, 'Approved')), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', NOT( OR( $Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission, $Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validations, $Setup.OpportunityAttribution__c.BypassValidation__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Deal Review must be 'Approved' before advancing to this stage. Please complete the Deal Review process or contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
